explanation: Chomsky Normal Form requires all production rules to be either A -> BC (two non-terminals) or A -> a (one terminal).
Regular, Decidable, and RE languages are closed under intersection. CFLs are not closed under intersection.
In CNF, deriving a string of length n takes exactly 2n - 1 steps. For n = 10, steps = 2*10 - 1 = 19.
